Through-thickness thermal conductivity: Hexcel values are in air (convection included), read from a chart; no vacuum value, and no conductivity for carbon honeycomb (a Boeing/Hexcel pitch-fibre honeycomb figure of 1.09-2.05 W/mK was seen only in a search snippet, not opened).
